data.one_liner: Provides compile-time constant data for world languages and scripts with ISO codes.
data.what_it_does: Provides information about world languages via compile-time, tree-shakable constant sealed classes. Includes ISO 639-1 and ISO 639-2 codes, native names, language families, right-to-left flags, and 140+ translations.
use_when: You need detailed metadata about world languages in your Dart or Flutter application.
You want compile-time constant, tree-shakable language objects with full type safety.
You need language name translations or language family lookups.
avoid_when: You need a UI language picker widget (use world_countries instead for Flutter widgets).
strengths: Compile-time constants with sealed class exhaustiveness.
Comprehensive coverage of 184 languages with ISO codes and translations.
weaknesses: Does not include Flutter UI widgets out of the box (delegated to world_countries).
